note: Friday B, Korean light maintenance（韩语轻维护）. Short session is enough. 事 si6 ×3, then 4 Hard café cards — say each aloud before flipping: 영수증 주세요, 따뜻한 걸로 주세요, 얼음, 여섯. Recap 일곱 / 다섯 / 다섯 개 주세요 / 여기요. No new cards. Write ×3 the Hard words. Watch ㅅ→t in 여섯 (same as 다섯). 5-Q quiz; finish on the Hard four. 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3, not falling like 時 si4.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (試 si3 is mid; 時 si4 falls; 事 si6 sits low and flat)

tasks.title: Read aloud: café lines (Hangul first, then check the gloss)

lines.translation: Excuse me. Five, please. · 喂，请给我五个。
The hot one, please. · 请来热的。
Six, please. The receipt, please. · 请给我六个。请给我收据。

tasks.prompt: Write ×3 then say the Hard four: 영수증 주세요 · 따뜻한 걸로 주세요 · 얼음 · 여섯. Then read the café lines twice, slow then normal. Watch ㅅ→t in 여섯 (same as 다섯). If you have a minute, one breath: Point → Reason → Example on why 여섯 and 다섯 both end in a t sound.
tasks.script:
Writing: 영수증 주세요 ×3 · 따뜻한 걸로 주세요 ×3 · 얼음 ×3 · 여섯 ×3.
Lines: 여기요. 다섯 개 주세요. / 따뜻한 걸로 주세요. / 얼음 주세요. / 여섯 개 주세요. 영수증 주세요. / 일곱 개 주세요.
Explanation: Point: 여섯 and 다섯 both end in a t sound. Reason: ㅅ at the bottom of a block (batchim) is pronounced t, not s. Example: 다섯 = daseot, 여섯 = yeoseot — same rule as 옷 and 셋.

questions.explain: 영수증 = receipt. 얼음 is ice; 따뜻한 걸로 주세요 is the hot one.

questions.q: The final sound in 여섯 and 다섯 is…
questions.explain: ㅅ at the bottom of a block sounds like t: 다섯 = daseot, 여섯 = yeoseot. Same rule as 옷 and 셋.
얼음 eoreum = ice 冰. Final ㅁ → m.
따뜻한 걸로 주세요 = the hot one, please. Contrast 아이스로 주세요 (the iced one). 여기요 calls the staff over.
여기요 = excuse me / over here, to call staff. 일곱 is seven; 영수증 주세요 is the receipt.
